newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Benelux 96 net 9.4 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Benelux 96 net 9.4 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Benelux Enterprise Co Ltd had net profits of 9.39 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.17 yuan in 1996 and turnover was 228.35 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.

The company posted net profits of 9.50 million yuan under Chinese accounting standards for 1995, according to the firm's 1995 annual report. It did not give a figure based on international accounting standards.
The firm proposed a one-for-10 bonus issue, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
